tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all tables in the workspace. Call this first to learn table and column slugs. Returns slug, name, row_count, and columns (slug, name, type, primary_key) for each table. Document-extracted tables include source_document {id, filename, url}. source_document is null for CSV, Excel, Google Sheets,

tools.name: list_relations
tools.description: List the relations (foreign keys) between tables in the workspace. Each relation has from and to as "table_slug.column_slug" and a kind. Use it to find which columns link two tables before calling related_rows. Read-only; returns an empty list when no relations are defined.

tools.name: query_table
tools.description: Read rows from a table. Optional filter is an exact-match map of column slug => value; optional search is a case-insensitive substring match across all cells. tools.name: related_rows
tools.description: Follow a relation from a source table to the rows it links to. Given a column on `table_slug` that participates in a relation and a `value` (usually a cell from a source row), returns the matching rows in the linked table. Works in both directions. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_relations" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
